1. Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State and Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, learned counsel for the respondent.
2. By the instant Criminal Miscellaneous Application, preferred under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023,

the present applicant is challenging the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 670 of 2024, State Vs.
Samreen Jamal, wherein the applicant has been summoned for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 504 IPC, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar arising out of the First Information Report dated 22.07.2023, lodged by respondent No. 2, bearing FIR No. 0278 of 2023, P.S. Jaspur, District Udham Singh Nagar.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant married with respondent No. 2 on 05.08.2020 and from this marriage there is no issue; however, due to some differences, a proceeding has been initiated by the present applicant under Section 498A, 323, 452, 354B, 504,
506 IPC read with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Bijnor and being prejudice with this

,
respondent No. 2 lodged the impugned FIR in which after conclusion of the investigation, the chargesheet has been filed.
He submits that in a very casual manner the Investigating Officer has submitted the chargesheet.

4. Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 submits that without disclosing this fact that the applicant who earlier married twice to other person, she again married with respondent No. 2 and it amounts to a cheating.
Apart from this, certain other allegations have also been alleged.
5. This is undisputed fact that the applicant married with respondent No. 2 and there is no divorce in between both of them therefore, efforts may be made for their amicable settlement.
6. Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State accepts notice for respondent No. 1.

Mr.
Bhuwan Bhatt, learned counsel accepts notice for respondent No. 2.
